input.quote: 2.1 Hosting Software License. Subject to the terms and conditions of this Agreement, Commerce One hereby grants to Corio a fee-bearing, perpetual and irrevocable, nonexclusive, nontransferable (except in accordance with Section 14.1 of this Agreement), right and license in the Territory to (i) reproduce the Software in machine executable object code format only for installation on the Corio Servers;
input.rationale: Direction: Commerce One (Vendor/Licensor) grants; Corio (our party) is the licensee, so the grant scope is ours to widen. Much of the preferred position is already met: the hosting and internal-use licences in 2.1 and 2.2 are perpetual and (for 2.1) irrevocable and fully paid up, Section 14.1 permits assignment to a successor in a merger/acquisition or asset sale, Section 11.2 allows termination only for uncured material breach, and Sections 11.3 and 14.9 protect continuity. The gap is scope of beneficiaries: the word "affiliate" appears nowhere in the agreement and no grant in Section 2 names contractors, even though Section 14.8 expressly contemplates Corio subcontracting portions of the Corio Services and Corio Servers may be "operated by or for Corio". Without an express extension, our affiliates and subcontractors exercising the licensed rights would be outside the grant and arguably infringing. Minimal fix: a new Section 2.11 extending the Section 2 licences to Corio affiliates and contractors acting on our behalf, with Corio responsible for their compliance; fallback is affiliate coverage on written notice.

proposal.summary: Extend the Section 2 licences to Corio affiliates and to contractors acting on Corio's behalf
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Section 2 licences run to Corio only and never mention our affiliates or the contractors we are expressly permitted to use under Section 14.8, so we have added a short subsection extending the grants to them with Corio remaining responsible for their compliance. Our position is that licences must cover affiliates and contractors acting on our behalf; if Commerce One prefers, we can accept affiliate coverage on written notice.

ops.text: 2.11 Affiliates and Contractors. The licenses granted to Corio under this Section 2 extend to Corio's affiliates and to contractors acting on Corio's behalf, in each case solely in connection with the Corio Services and Corio's internal business operations, provided that Corio shall remain responsible for their compliance with the terms and conditions of this Agreement.
